name: Philly Cheesesteak
instructions: Ask your butcher to slice the ribeye paper-thin, or freeze 30 minutes and slice yourself.
Heat oil in a large cast iron skillet over high heat.
Cook onion, stirring, until caramelized, about 8 minutes. Push to the side.
Add steak in a single layer. Season and cook 1-2 minutes, then chop and stir with onions.
Add Worcestershire sauce. Divide meat into 2 portions in the pan.
Lay 3 slices of provolone over each portion. Cover 1 minute until melted.

substitutions.dairy_free: Skip cheese or use dairy-free provolone.
substitutions.low_carb: Serve the steak mixture over cauliflower rice or in lettuce cups.

notes: Very thin slicing is everything. Ask your butcher or partially freeze the meat first.
